title: dispatch-gates：改了 *.metadata-form.ts 时没有派生出对应的 lint 测试
body:
repo:objectstack#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibyUSf2nKJWW6qBemSU

Filing gate: ① (b) follow-up named by L1-a on PR #38078 (#36799): contract record 7232601911, L1 7232611473. Source: fleet.
Grading: area:build · Bug · p3 · reach: every card that edits a `*.metadata-form.ts` file and runs the derived gates locally · evidence: reviewer read; #36799's claim needed a hand amendment (7232140022) to add the lint test.
Dedupe: "dispatch-gates metadata-form lint", "derived gates metadata-form.ts" → 0.

## 维护者速读

- 问题：开发者本地跑派生门禁（dispatch-gates）时，改了 `*.metadata-form.ts` 文件却不会派生出检查这些表单的 lint 测试。这次 #36799 是靠认领时手工补了一条才跑到的，下次容易漏掉，要到 CI 才发现。
- 修法：在 dispatch-gates 的派生规则里，把 `*.metadata-form.ts` 映射到对应的 lint 测试。
- 要你做的：无。

## Ask

1. `dispatch-gates` derives the metadata-form lint test(s) from any `*.metadata-form.ts` path in the diff.
2. A self-test case for the new mapping, with an ablation.

## Acceptance

- A diff that touches only a `*.metadata-form.ts` file lists the lint test in `dispatch-gates --ran`.
